modules.module_title: Develop and maintain lifeguards at the beach

pcs.pc_description: recommend workforce requirements for rescue and operations at the beach
plan a mix of full-time, part-time, temporary, and contractual members appropriate to the requirement at the beach
ensure all life guards have required and updated certifications as life savers
ensure that lifeguards meet the required level of physical fitness
identify training needs of the team members and recommend development requirements
ensure a diverse workforce is recruited
conduct mock-drills of rescue operation in a simulated environment

modules.module_title: Plan the operations of the beach

pcs.pc_description: ensure beach area and facilities comply to the safety and legal requirements
create SOP (standard operating procedure) of the beach
plan how the attendance and identification of the team members are recorded
create roster of all lifeguards and support staff to assign them to their designated places
ensure watercrafts, rescue equipment are adequate and in working condition for immediate rescue response
record the maintenance schedule of equipment and machinery as per the safety standards
ensure adequate medical equipment are readily available (artificial resuscitation, oxygen mask, stretcher, etc.)
ensure public address equipment such as loud speakers, mics, whistle are within reach
ensure communication devices such as radio, GPS units, mobile phones, are adequate for the team

modules.module_title: Conduct daily risk assessment and duty allocation

pcs.pc_description: obtain weather forecast, tidal/surf conditions and plan for the day
identify supervision requirements for the day
carry out risk analysis
confirm and document report on demarcation of swimming and non-swimming zones
assign watersport teams to their designated area
conduct briefing for the day and confirm understanding by each team member
ensure all communication broadcasting is functional

modules.module_title: Manage safety standards at the beach

pcs.pc_description: ensure people adhere to safety guidelines
apply crowd management strategies at places that are overcrowded
ensure entry-exit, changing facilities, for people with different abilities are not misused
ensure any signs of harassment, bullying, etc. and immediately report for prompt action
verify non-movement of any vehicles at the beach and ensure they are removed
broadcast swimmers, lifeguards in time about the abnormal movements of watercrafts near swimming area
conduct emergency evacuation in case of any emergency broadcast by safety authorities, warning sirens, calls, news, etc.
perform CPR when required
advise team members on the emergency procedures during rescue operations
ensure swimmers in distress are identified and/or information about distress is received from team members
recognize the need for additional lifeguards in case of multiple victims and reinforce promptly
ensure first aid is applied for minor injuries
monitor the condition of the casualty and plan course of action
report and prepare medical team for en- route and arrival of survivors or casualties, if any
assess the level of emergency and initiate emergency protocols with nearby hospitals and authorities as per the policy
conduct the process of deep sea search and rescue operation in case of missing of the victim/s in the water
record details of the incident and the action taken using appropriate forms, according to organizational policies and procedures

modules.module_title: Maintain hygiene and sanitation standards at the beach

pcs.pc_description: ensure personal hygiene
ensure rescue equipment, personal safety gears, etc. are sanitized before and after the usage
guide others about hygiene and sanitation requirements
ensure availability of running water, hand wash and alcohol-based sanitizers
ensure everyone cleans hands with soap or alcohol-based sanitizer
ensure team members who are ill are not deployed for supervision and rescue
conduct routine hygiene and sanitation checks of equipment and beach area
ensure support staff controls littering and pollution at the beach
report advanced hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority
